text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Ngh, I can keep going! —Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Such incredible grit!
No, but... so do I! Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—52 minutes.
We have arrived at Ibarafune Training Center
precisely on schedule.
Both sleep duration and caloric intake are
in perfect balance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Additionally,
regarding the strength training we playfully
engaged in with everyone in the dorms last
night,
I have calculated the workload for each
routine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Based on these data,
I request your final review of today's
training menu intensity.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Umasta, Umatter, Umatok.
And then Umatube. So—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: “Buena Vista: Tenno Sho (Autumn)”

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It really is a treasure trove of video
material.
Through the countless cameras held by the
spectators,
we can observe her running form from every
angle.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: What is it? Speak.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, it merely occurred to me...
just how much
I am able to learn from everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Interspersed with joint training alongside
her peers,
the days leading up to the Japan Cup flew
by like an arrow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so,
the final day of joint training arrived.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haah, whew—!
Aaargh, that took forever!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
With this,
all regimens in our joint training session
are complete.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
And tomorrow is—
the day of our decisive battle.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...—Everyone.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the chance,
why don't you take a short rest?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
All of you are showing remarkable upward
momentum.
Both your Japan Cup and my graded stakes
race
should be met in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. —Once again, my gratitude.
The days spent training alongside all of
you are what made me this strong.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I wish to dedicate myself to racing even
further in this country.
That such a desire has grown so profoundly
is surely owed to the presence of you all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I believe it was only because everyone was
there
that we could bring such a grand circle of
connection to the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: In that case... allow me as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
For my ambition—
the eternal peace of the Rose Kingdom—
your presence was indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to express my gratitude once
more,
as the representative of the Rose clan.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...You are always thinking of your family,
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Rose.
There's something I've been wondering about
for a while.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You are truly a prince bearing the burden
of your clan.
The weight resting on your shoulders is not
hard to imagine.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Watching you, sometimes I—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the autumn,
and through the winter still.
Even if fiercer battles await us
upon an even greater stage.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
With this body alone,
I shall show them hope
and lead the Rose Clan forward.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
That is the true caliber of a monarch—
for only then
can the peace of the Rose Kingdom be
realized...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...There is something on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Don't you—grow sick of it?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I had never even considered it.
Dislike, huh...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...If you mean pressure,
it's not as though I've never felt it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
He knows all too well.
That I am far more immature,
ignorant,
and shallow a child than anyone expects.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
She knows all too well.
That I am far more immature,
ignorant,
and shallow a child than anyone expects.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...However.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Well now,
Rose. You've grown taller again.
Come here!
Still accompanied by your canine king today,
I see.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Within the Rose Clan, there are kin
who have showered me with love ever since
I was a child.

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Grandmother. Next time, for certain—!
At the upcoming Queen Elizabeth II Cup,
I will break this curse of thorns once and
for all!

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
Aaargh—! We were so close!
I am so sorry!
...To everyone in the clan...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Pouring body and soul into fulfilling that
long-cherished dream,
tasting defeat, and then――

text_block_list.name: Rose Clan Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, Rose,
you can surely carve out a future
for our Rose Clan.
Will you carry these hopes upon your
shoulders?

text_block_list.name: Young Rose
text_block_list.text: Yes, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And my companions of the Rose Clan
entrusted that dream to me.

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Based on the test results given to you
trainers recently,
I would like to speak once more about a
vital phase
of the training cycle: 'Rest.'

text_block_list.name: Top Trainer
text_block_list.text:
As for how much "rest" is required— First,
please direct your attention to Figure 3,
which illustrates
the recovery process across varying training
loads.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There are Trainers serving our family who
always hold our best interests at heart.

text_block_list.name: Supporters' Associat...
text_block_list.text:
I have taken the liberty of sending
sportswear
as a gift for everyone in the Rose Clan.

text_block_list.name: Supporters' Associat...
text_block_list.text:
Someday, surely.
I believe it can be achieved.

text_block_list.name: Foundation Staff
text_block_list.text:
We have officially embarked on the development
of a brand-new training facility!

text_block_list.name: Foundation Staff
text_block_list.text:
Though it may not be on a grand scale,
it is a training facility
equipped with cutting-edge machines.
May it be of some help in fulfilling your
long-cherished dream.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There are those who have supported us for
generations,
whole-heartedly praying for our
prosperity.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
When I think of them,
boundless strength wells within me.
I could pursue victory without end.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that is why.
Heavy as this dream may be—
I have never once considered letting it
go.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...—I see.
No wonder it made no sense to me.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
You truly harbor a deep love
for the Rose Clan itself, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
—Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To me, perhaps the Rose Clan
is the very definition of happiness
itself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—
There is still time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Once we return to the dorms,
let us review the race footage.
It should at least serve to aid our
simulations.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
You have my gratitude.
Let us continue our pursuit of victory
together for a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now,
the biggest showdown of the autumn races—
the Japan Cup is underway!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are naturally on Buena Vista.
Putting two lengths between herself and
second place in the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
she now reigns as the 'Strongest Active
Umamusume.'

text_block_list.name: Buena's Fans
text_block_list.text:
“Buenaaaa!”
“Show us your 6th GⅠ victory!”
“You can do it, Buena-chan!”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, as always,
for your immense love!
Today—I will surely repay it with victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooohhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What overwhelming frenzy—
No. Do not let it rush you into making a
blunder.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Pisa-san, Flash-san.
And... Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No matter how formidable the foe,
I will not yield.
Because I want to show everyone an even more
magnificent view...!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...—Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Those cheers...
It feels as if they have the entire racecourse
on their side.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
So this is your strength,
Buena...! But that is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Today, I shall bring you down.
As the bearer of the Rose Clan's name!
